title: BACS Direct Debit indemnity claim reversal status change.
description: Bankers' Automated Clearing System (BACS) Direct Debit Indemnity Claim (DDIC) reversal event data. A reversal withdraws a previously raised, delivery-confirmed indemnity claim. This event is emitted when a reversal is created and on every subsequent status transition (`PROCESSING`, `CONFIRMED`, `FAILED`).

id.title: ID
id.description: Pismo claim reversal ID. Use this ID to fetch or reference the reversal in Pismo BACS claim APIs. To cross-reference the reversal at the provider, use `reversal_id`.

reversal_id.title: Reversal ID
reversal_id.description: Provider (Form3) reversal ID. You can use this to link the reversal in our system to the provider's reversal. Absent until the reversal is submitted to the scheme.

claim_id.title: Claim ID
claim_id.description: Pismo ID of the parent claim being reversed.

original_instruction_id.title: Original instruction ID
original_instruction_id.description: The DDIC Sequence Number of the claim being reversed, forwarded to the scheme.

org_id.title: Org ID
org_id.description: Organization ID that owns the reversal

status.title: Status
status.description: Reversal status. `CREATED` (persisted, awaiting submission), `PROCESSING` (submitted to the scheme via Form3), `CONFIRMED` (delivery confirmed, terminal), `FAILED` (rejected or failed validation/submission, terminal).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Free-text reason associated with the reversal status, typically populated when a reversal is `FAILED`.
